newsitem.title: USA: Orbit sees revs H2 revs higher than H1.
newsitem.headline: Orbit sees revs H2 revs higher than H1.

text.p: Orbit International Corp said Monday that based on current delivery schedules, it expects revenues in the second half of 1997 to exceed first half results.
Orbit reported second quarter earnings of $0.07 a share from continuing operations on sales of $4.4 million, compared to $0.18 a share on sales of $4.9 million the previous second quarter.
Earnings for the first half of the year were $0.13 a share on sales of $8.4 million versus $0.31 a share on sales of $7.8 million the same period last year.
Six months 1996 results included $0.14 a share in royalty income from a former affiliate.
